status: accepted DOS landing, palette, and replayed surface-sector reference with native seed match
initial_state: A fresh disposable root used seed_felysia_system.py --planetary-map-pose to select FELYSIA P04 and place the player beside the far-right planetary-map screen. The replay used a fresh root plus the first run's 45-byte SURFACE.BIN.
steps: Copy pinned data/, modules/, and dosbox.conf into a disposable root and verify their hashes.

Run python3 docs/porting/fixtures/seed_felysia_system.py --planetary-map-pose docs/porting/fixtures/F01C_MIRACLE/seed-current.bin DISPOSABLE/data/CURRENT.BIN and verify hash b7a084e3cb002a1306752479e171f0b5d786457b7d0663dd4a7c3387179477f2.
Launch the pinned DOS executable. Select Flight Control with 5 and deploy the surface capsule with 9. At the far-right map, move longitude once to LQ 001:060 and press Enter.
Wait until the capsule transition finishes and the surface HUD is stable. Record the green-dominant palette and vegetated terrain. Press Escape once to serialize data/SURFACE.BIN and exit normally.

Create a second fresh root from the unmodified system seed, copy run 1 SURFACE.BIN into data/, and launch. No landing input is required: Noctis regenerates and enters the same surface state. Capture the settled view and exit once to serialize the replay state.

palette_observation.classification: green-dominant surface palette with dark green terrain, bright green vegetation, and pale green/pink highlights
palette_observation.stability: Palette values and pixels vary with surface time, exposure, animation, and viewing angle; classification and representative colors are perceptual evidence, not an exact palette golden.

capture_retention: Screenshots and SURFACE.BIN files remain outside Git. Their hashes, decoded fields, raw bytes, and exact regeneration procedure are retained here and in surface-state.txt.
comparison_level: EXACT landing coordinates, atlas coordinates, position, HUD state, and native surface seeds; STRUCTURAL terrain/vegetation; PERCEPTUAL palette and frames; viewing angle and pixels are time/input dependent
notes: The replay preserves every serialized field except user_beta, which changed with mouse input after entry. The landing and replay both show a dark green vegetated type-3 surface. This fixture protects seed selection and records the DOS appearance; full native terrain/render parity belongs to M4.
